About.heroSubtitle: From a small family orchard to a leading regional supplier, our journey is rooted in passion for the perfect apple.
About.storyContent: Founded by the Fiutowski family, our orchard began with a simple vision: to grow the best-tasting apples in the region using traditional methods combined with modern care. Over the decades, we've expanded our varieties and sustainable practices, but our core commitment to quality remains unchanged. Every tree is tended to with personal attention, ensuring that the fruit you enjoy is as nature intended.
About.missionContent: To provide our community with fresh, healthy, and delicious fruit while preserving the environment for future generations through sustainable farming practices.

Hero.title: Best taste, best quality
Hero.subtitle: We are a team of passionate farmers who are dedicated to providing the best quality apples to our customers.

WhyChooseUs.title: Why Choose Our Harvest?
WhyChooseUs.subtitle: We bring you the authentic taste of nature with a commitment to quality that you can trust.

sustainable.title: Sustainable Farming
sustainable.description: We prioritize eco-friendly practices to protect our land and ensure healthy, natural growth for generations to come.

quality.title: Premium Quality
quality.description: Every apple is hand-selected at the perfect moment of ripeness, ensuring exceptional taste and texture.

direct.title: Direct from Orchard
direct.description: Our streamlined supply chain moves fruit from our trees to your hands quickly, preserving maximum freshness.

ProductShowcase.title: Our Varieties
ProductShowcase.subtitle: Explore our selection of premium apples, grown with care and harvested at peak ripeness.

gala.name: Gala
gala.description: Sweet, aromatic, and crisp. Perfect for snacking and salads.

golden-delicious.name: Golden Delicious
golden-delicious.description: Explosively crisp and juicy with a perfect balance of sweet and tart.

ligol.name: Ligol
ligol.description: Large, crunchy, with a distinctive sweet-sour taste. Excellent for storage.

Contact.title: Get in Touch
Contact.subtitle: We're here to help. Reach out to us for any inquiries about our apples, partnership opportunities, or general questions.
